Contender Solutions Enhancement Pack - Discovery - Cisco LWAP and controllers. © 2016 Contender Solutions LLC. Author: Derek Page (dpage@contendersolutions.com) Date: 1/11/2016
Version 1.0
This enhancement pack adds functionality for discovering Cisco WAP controllers and their connected AP's. Cisco WAP controllers must be discovered via the SNMP sysObjectID, as ServiceNow discovery provides no mechanism for classifying them as WAP controllers based on general MIB-2 data (as of Fuji). This enhancement pack ships with several defined sysObjectID classifiers for devices known to be WAP controllers. If additional models are needed they can easily be added to the SNMP System OID's list.
Version 1.1
Added support for retrieving Serial Number and Make/Model information for WAP's built by Airespace Corp. using that company's legacy MIB (the Cisco MIB doesn't report this information on individual AP's). NOTE: The IMPORTS section of the legacy Airespace MIB's had to be modified slightly to reference the SNMPv2 MIB's loaded in ServiceNow, which have a slighly different name.

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="discovery_sensor"><discovery_sensor action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><agent/><apply_defaults>true</apply_defaults><classification_type/><coalesce/><condition_script/><data_option>insert_update</data_option><data_source/><description>SNMP - Cisco LWAP Sensor (CS)</description><external_names/><java_class/><major_version>1</major_version><minor_version>0</minor_version><name>SNMP - Cisco WAP Controller (CS)</name><order/><parent/><reacts_to_probe display_value="SNMP - Cisco WAP Controller (CS)">3369023b0ff49600b1264d9ce1050e5e</reacts_to_probe><script><![CDATA[new DiscoverySensor({
    
	process: function(result) {	
		this.ciData = new CIData();
		this.ciData.fromXML(this.getParameter('cidata'));
		this.ci_data = this.ciData.getData();
		
		var snmp = new SNMPResponse(result);
		var capabilities = {};
		if (g_device) {
		   var status = new DiscoveryStatus('' + g_device.getStatus());
		   capabilities['discover'] = status.discover;
		}
		var props = {};	
		
		this.analyze(snmp, capabilities, props);
    },	
	
	analyze: function(snmp, capabilities, props) {
		
		//current date is latest discovery date.
		var lastDiscoDate = new GlideDateTime();
		
        //get the parent WAP Controller CI 
        var controller = new GlideRecord("u_cmdb_ci_wap_controller");
		controller.addQuery("u_active", true);
		controller.addQuery("ip_address", snmp.snmp['@ip']);
		controller.query();
		//if not found then quit.  This should already exist since we're in exploration phase.
		if (!controller.next()) {
			//log that the CI wasn't found and return.
			this.handleError([("Unable to find the CI for the WAP Controller at IP " + snmp.snmp['@ip'])]);
			return;
		}
		
		//relationship type created between WAP controller and WAP's
		var relTypeName = "Connects to::Connected by";
		
		//keep track of all WAP's created or updated on this run.  We will use this later to dissociate any existing WAP to controller
		//associations which are no longer valid (might happen if a WAP is decomissioned or moved to a different controller(s)
		var currentWAPList = [];
		
		//get all the WAP devices from the standard Cisco MIB AP Table (master list of AP's on this controller).
        var devices = snmp.getOIDTable("iso.org.dod.internet.private.enterprises.cisco.ciscoMgmt.ciscoLwappApMIB.ciscoLwappApMIBObjects.ciscoLwappAp", 'cLApEntry');
		
		//Check if the Airespace MIB returned any AP data (will only be non-null if Airespace AP's are attached to the controller).
		var airespaceDeviceArr = snmp.getOIDTable("iso.org.dod.internet.private.enterprises.airespace.bsnWireless.bsnAP", 'bsnAPEntry');
		var airespaceDevices = {};		
		if (JSUtil.notNil(airespaceDeviceArr)) {
			
			//add all of the found Airespace MIB's to a quick lookup map by MAC address so the data can be added to AP CI's as we process
			//the AP List from the Cisco MIB.
			for (var adIndex in airespaceDeviceArr) {
			
				//get current Airespace device data.
            	var adDevice = airespaceDeviceArr[adIndex];
				
				//MAC is our unique key for WAP's so if we don't have this info then we can't create a CI for it
				if (JSUtil.notNil(adDevice["bsnAPEthernetMacAddress"])) {
					//create new string of MAC address and do a toLower to prevent mismatch issues due to case.
					var aMac = ("" + adDevice["bsnAPEthernetMacAddress"]).toLowerCase();
					airespaceDevices[aMac] = adDevice;
				}
			}
		}
		
		//process each entry from the main Cisco AP table.
        for (var index in devices) {
			
			//get current device data.
            var device = devices[index];
			
			//MAC is our unique key for WAP's so if we don't have this info then we can't create a CI for it
			if (JSUtil.notNil(device["cLApIfMacAddress"])) {
				var deviceMAC = "" + (device["cLApIfMacAddress"]).toLowerCase();
			
				//try to find an existing CI.
				var wap = new GlideRecord("u_cmdb_ci_wap");
				wap.addQuery("u_active", true);			
				wap.addQuery("mac_address", device["cLApIfMacAddress"]);
				wap.query();
				
				//if we found existing CI(s)
				if (wap.next()) {
					
					//if we find more than one then we can't proceed.
					if (wap.getRowCount() > 1) {
						this.handleError([("Non-unique CI match.  Found " + wap.getRowCount() + " ACTIVE WAP CI's for MAC: " + device["cLApIfMacAddress"])]);
						continue;  //done for this device.
					}
					
				//else if we don't find it then create it
				} else {
					wap = new GlideRecord("u_cmdb_ci_wap");
					wap.initialize();
					//have to set MAC address on insert.
					wap.mac_address = device["cLApIfMacAddress"];
					wap.insert();
				}
				
				//create intermediary object to keep track of all fields to be updated.
				var wapCI = {};
				
				//the following data points from the Cisco MIB AP table are updated everytime the WAP is discovered.
				wapCI.name = device["cLApName"];			
				wapCI.last_discovered = lastDiscoDate;
				wapCI.discovery_source = "ServiceNow";
				wapCI.location = controller.location;				
				
				//if there is an Airespace entry for this WAP then add the data from that as well
				var airespaceDevice = airespaceDevices[deviceMAC];
				if (JSUtil.notNil(airespaceDevice)) {
					wapCI.ip_address = airespaceDevice['bsnApIpAddress'];
					wapCI.serial_number = airespaceDevice['bsnAPSerialNumber'];
					
					//get the make and model if provided and set the references appropriately.
					var manufacturer = "Airespace";  //Hardcode the manufacturer as Airespace since we know that's what it is.
					var modelID = airespaceDevice['bsnAPModel'];
					if (JSUtil.notNil(modelID)) {
						var mam = MakeAndModel.fromNames(manufacturer, modelID);	
						wapCI.manufacturer = mam.getManufacturerSysID();
						wapCI.model_id = mam.getModelNameSysID();
					}
					
					//attempt to set the firmware version from the Airespace provided attributes, in the following orderr
					if (airespaceDevice['bsnAPBootVersion']) {
						wapCI.firmware_version = airespaceDevice['bsnAPBootVersion'];
					} else if (airespaceDevice['bsnAPSoftwareVersion']) {
						wapCI.firmware_version = airespaceDevice['bsnAPSoftwareVersion'];
					} else if (airespaceDevice['bsnAPIOSVersion']) {
						wapCI.firmware_version = airespaceDevice['bsnAPIOSVersion'];
					}
				}
				
				//set all update values onto the GlideRecord for update
				for (var valu in wapCI) {
					wap[valu] = wapCI[valu];
				}
				
				//update the CI
				wap.update();
				
				//add this WAP to the current list
				currentWAPList.push("" + wap.sys_id);
				
				//check for a relationship between this WAP and the controller we found it on.
				var parentCI = wap.sys_id;
				var childCI = controller.sys_id;
				
				var rel = new GlideRecord("cmdb_rel_ci");
				rel.addQuery("parent", parentCI);
				rel.addQuery("type.name", relTypeName);
				rel.addQuery("child", childCI);
				rel.query();
				//if no existing relationship then add one.
				if (!rel.hasNext()) {
					rel = new GlideRecord("cmdb_rel_ci");
					rel.initialize();
					rel.parent = parentCI;
					rel.setDisplayValue("type", relTypeName);
					rel.child = childCI;
					rel.insert();
				}
			}
        }
		
		//finally, let's remove any WAP to controller associations which are no longer valid.
		if (currentWAPList.length > 0) {
			
			//search for any relationships to the current controller and WAP's that are NOT in the list of ones we just found			
			var existingRel = new GlideRecord("cmdb_rel_ci");
			existingRel.addQuery("child", controller.sys_id);
			existingRel.addQuery("type.name", relTypeName);			
			//add all WAP sys_id's			
			for (var i = 0; i < currentWAPList.length; i++) {
				existingRel.addQuery("parent", "!=", currentWAPList[i]);
			}			
			existingRel.query();
			existingRel.deleteMultiple();
		}
    },
    
    type: 'DiscoverySensor'
});]]></script><sensor_type>Javascript</sensor_type><sys_class_name>discovery_sensor</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>dpage@contendersolutions.com</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2016-01-13 22:07:52</sys_created_on><sys_customer_update>true</sys_customer_update><sys_id>b7e9823b0ff49600b1264d9ce1050eda</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>SNMP - Cisco WAP Controller (CS)</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_replace_on_upgrade>false</sys_replace_on_upgrade><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>discovery_sensor_b7e9823b0ff49600b1264d9ce1050eda</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>dpage@contendersolutions.com</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2016-02-10 17:04:59</sys_updated_on><table/><type>data_source</type><xml_root_node/></discovery_sensor></record_update>
